$comment: Inventory of the owner-supplied LPU isometric artwork. Labels are transcribed EXACTLY as printed (typos kept) and verified by eye on zoomed crops; OCR was not relied on. Artwork/index numbers are NOT official LPU block numbers. Nothing here names, numbers or positions a real building on the geographic map. DRAFT for owner review; not applied data.

provenance.ownerStatement: I own or am authorized to use the artwork
provenance.originalDesignTool: Adobe Illustrator CS6 (from the master JPEG XMP; created 2019-04-25)
provenance.earlierResearch: docs/research/block-leads/ transcribed byte-identical copies named slide-NN (git-ignored reference/assets/behance-slides/, never committed). earlierResearchName maps each asset to that name.
provenance.handling: Originals are never modified, renamed or re-encoded. Derived copies live elsewhere and record the source sha256.

conventions.ids: iso-art-NNN, where NNN is the leading number of the original file name, zero-padded. Label ids are <asset id>/L<n> in reading order.
conventions.coordinates: Source pixels, origin top-left, x right, y down. nx = x / width and ny = y / height, in [0, 1]. Each asset records its coordinateSpace.

confidence.medium: words exact; spacing or punctuation uncertain

conventions.textFields: "lines" are the printed lines; "text" joins them with one space. Internal spacing (including double spaces) is kept as seen.

assets.colorSpace: CMYK
assets.iccProfile: U.S. Web Coated (SWOP) v2 (embedded across 18 APP2 segments)
assets.webNote: CMYK JPEG. Chromium decodes it with the embedded profile. Derived web copies must be converted to sRGB by a colour-managed decoder and compared visually against the original; never re-save over the original.

regionsApprox.note: Measured by eye on a 0.4x gridded render; +-15 px. Boxes are [x, y, w, h] in source pixels.

informationIndex.heading: INFORMATION
informationIndex.note: Rows transcribed top to bottom exactly as printed. "21A,B" is read as 21A and 21B; that split interprets the printed shorthand.

labels.note: This row has a number but NO printed label, as printed.
Text around the circular LPU emblem (part of the LPU logo as drawn in the artwork; not a place label).

labels.text: L OVELY P ROFESSIONAL U NIVERSITY
labels.note: Wordmark: the initials L, P, U sit in orange boxes followed by "OVELY", "ROFESSIONAL", "NIVERSITY" (reads LOVELY PROFESSIONAL UNIVERSITY).
Script tagline under the wordmark (mixed case as printed).

Index RESIDENTIAL "GIRLS HOSTEL 9,10, 11,12, 21A,B"; vignette 21 = "SCHOOL OF LAW"; vignette "BLOCK-22,23 GIRLS HOSTAL 5, 6." has no index row and no overview pins. Relationship between 21A/21B and 22/23 is unknown.
